service_id.description: UUID of the Plural service (from plrl_cluster_services or the API)

vuln_reports.description: If true, include simplified vulnerability reports for the service in the response

components.description: Optionally include the service's Kubernetes components in the response. Use search to filter by component api version, kind, namespace, name, or regex patterns like apps/.*/prod/api.*.

fetch.description: If true, include the service's Kubernetes components in the response
